draft.title: Neptune opposite Lilith
draft.humanMoment: A record lottery jackpot sends ticket lines around city blocks while a rent-relief hearing across town fills with tenants asking for one month without arrears.
draft.developmentDetail: News interviews dwell on mansions and resignations, but repeated comments return to clearing bills, reducing shifts, and caring for relatives.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Neptune supplies the fantasy of sudden escape, while Lilith carries the ordinary want for security that hides inside it.
draft.aspectMechanic: The opposition places jackpot fantasies in the ticket lines across from plain demands at the rent-relief hearing, so neither the dream of escape nor the unmet need behind it can be edited out of the public response.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If the surge is treated as entertainment alone, the hearing may expose how much of the spending came from ordinary needs with no other visible outlet.

judge.weakest: If the surge is treated as entertainment alone, the hearing may expose how much of the spending came from ordinary needs with no other visible outlet.
judge.why: The consequence is slightly interpretive about spending motives, but it remains conditional, scene-based, collective, and consistent with the concealed ordinary want beneath the fantasy.
